hook.name: C47Hook
hook.description: Only beforeAddLiquidity is hooked (swaps, removals and donations are not). Liquidity can be added only by one address, through the canonical PositionManager (checked via its msgSender()). Pools use the dynamic LP fee flag: the opening fee is set from the first mint's hookData, and afterwards only that same address can change it with setFee. Not upgradeable.
